# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS

## BOOK 1: The Datchet Diamonds (Richard Marsh, Gutenberg 40353)

Illustrated by Stanley L. Wood. Frontispiece: "Shall I shoot all three of you?" (p.265). Chapters: I Two Men and a Maid; II Overheard in the Train; III The Diamonds; IV Miss Wentworth's Rudeness; V In the Bodega; VI The Adventures of a Night; VII The Datchet Diamonds Are Placed in Safe Custody; VIII In the Moment of His Success; IX A Proposal of Marriage; X Cyril's Friend; XI John Ireland's Warrant; XII A Woman Roused; XIII The Detective and the Lady; XIV Among Thieves; XV Put to the Question; XVI A Modern Instance of an Ancient Practice; XVII The Most Dangerous Foe of All; XVIII The Last of the Datchet Diamonds; XIX A Woman's Logic.

**Characters**
- Daisy Strong (Miss Strong): Brighton woman, ~£120/yr from late mother; loves Cyril; friend/housemate of Charlie.
- Cyril Paxton (Mr. Paxton): City speculator, gambler; lost on "Eries" (bull position); bought 10,000 Trumpit Gold Mine shares; memory for faces; owns revolver; rents safe at Chancery Lane Deposit Co.
- Charlotte "Charlie" Wentworth (Miss Wentworth): 30, writer (fashion, fiction, etc.), earns ~£500/yr, wears pince-nez, blunt; calls Cyril unreliable.
- Mr. Lawrence (alias Reginald Hargraves, "The Toff"): fair, blue eyes, soft voice, pink-white complexion; a thief; met Daisy on Devil's Dyke via umbrella in rain; proposed to Daisy.
- The Baron (Isaac Bergstein, German-American): tall, thin, stoop, long black overcoat, huge top hat, hooked talon-nail, huge mouth, asks "eh?"; uses branding irons, revolver.
- John Ireland: Scotland Yard detective (Inspector, CID); bet Mr. Franklyn £100 at evens; has warrant for Paxton.
- Mr. Franklyn: ~40, grey-streaked black hair, solicitor, Cyril's friend and Trumpit shares holder/strongbox keeper.
- Stephen Eversleigh: duke's manservant, short-sighted, gold-cased spectacles.
- Skittles: ruffian with pail, bald-ish, ears like flappers; burned Paxton.
- Bill Cooper: undersized informer ("Bill Cooper"); "Tom the Toff" and "the Baron" named as thieves.
- George Hollier: policeman set to tail Franklyn.
- Treadwater: Makell's Hotel manager; clerk with curled moustache.
- Duchess of Datchet; Duke of Datchet.

**Events in order**
1. Pier, Brighton. Daisy and Lawrence walk; Cyril arrives. Cyril says he's "going for the gloves" — bull on Eries; will win or lose Daisy; Daisy says if he loses, they must part. Cyril: "Next week I emigrate." Kiss.
2. Train: newspaper: Duchess of Datchet's diamonds (£250,000) stolen; despatch-box empty at Grosvenor Square (Bartlett's Bank agent). Cyril overhears Lawrence and German-American in next compartment: swapped boxes at Windsor station using duplicate spectacle case photographed by "friend"; Eversleigh (spectacles) gave up box. Lawrence travelled with box via South-Western line.
3. Brighton Central refreshment room: Paxton and Lawrence's Gladstone bags swapped. Paxton finds diamonds in his bag (Amsterdam Necklace ~£100,000; Datchet Tiara, Begum's Brooch, Banee's Bracelet). Hides them in Gladstone in Makell's Hotel.
4. Daisy at pier gate; Paxton says he'll get ~£250,000; Daisy proposes marriage within a month; "Whither thou goest" (Ruth). Charlie refuses congratulations; quarrel; Paxton storms out.
5. Bodega: Lawrence and German-American confront Paxton about Gladstone bag; Ireland appears; Paxton denies. Ireland hints he knows where diamonds are; Paxton denies knowing.
6. Night: followed through West Street; ladder at window; Paxton fires revolver at intruder on ladder; lantern shattered.
7. Next morning: Paxton moves diamonds to Chancery Lane safe; tailed by man; jostled at London Bridge.
8. Trumpit shares boom to £10+; Paxton's ~10,000 shares. Man at Makell's claims to fetch Gladstone; Paxton's Trumpit wealth.
9. Lawrence proposes to Daisy on pier; Daisy says she's engaged to Paxton. Paxton fails to meet Daisy; Franklyn arrives; Ireland tells Franklyn of warrant; Franklyn bets Ireland £100.
10. Ireland shows ring ("dropped from Paxton's handkerchief") — one of stolen rings. Ireland and Hollier. Daisy confronts Ireland, Treadwater; Ireland searches; Bill Cooper tells of Tom the Toff and the Baron kidnapping Paxton; leads Ireland and Daisy by cab to police.
11. Paxton captured by Lawrence's gang at a "crib" (blacksmith forge); tied, chloroformed, hot pail, Baron shoots at him. Paxton frees hands, burns Skittles, knocks Baron down and Lawrence. Lamp smashed; fire; Paxton locked in pantry-closet; writes will ("all I have... to Daisy Strong"). Rescued by Daisy through window; police found outlaws.
12. Paxton recovers at Miss Wentworth's house, guarded by a policeman. Confesses. Diamonds recovered from safe. Lawrence (Reginald Hargraves) and Baron (Isaac Bergstein): 20 years penal servitude.
13. Epilogue: Paxton realizes Trumpit shares; invests in consols. Marries Daisy quietly at Brighton church. "God grant that I may never again be led into such temptation!"

## BOOK 2: When Oriole Traveled Westward (Amy Bell Marlowe, Gutenberg 76223)

Series: Oriole Putnam books; prior volume "When Oriole Came to Harbor Light." Grosset & Dunlap, 1921. Chapters I–XXX (I Adventure on the Ice; II Teddy Ford; III Strange Actions; IV Oriole Is Worried; V What Happened in the Night; VI Teddy Ford's Story; VII Other People's Troubles; VIII Oriole's Own Troubles; IX A Great Change Coming; X Partings; XI A Great Deal That Is New; XII Exciting Times; XIII At the Range Camp; XIV Ching Foo; XV Molly; XVI The Spring Round-Up; XVII The Bird of Freedom; XVIII A New Deal; XIX An Exciting Fishing Party; XX Bruin on the Line; XXI News of Moment; XXII Something Going On; XXIII Suspicion Is Rife; XXIV The Twins in Trouble; XXV Nature's Wonders; XXVI At Close Quarters; XXVII The Wrist Watch; XXVIII Shall Oriole Be Told?; XXIX Of Course!; XXX The Promise of the Future).

**Characters**
- Oriole Putnam: Brazilian-raised girl (Bahia), parents Mr. Putnam ("Noddy") and Mrs. Putnam ("Sister"); shipwrecked on *Helvetia*, rescued by *Adrian Marple*; lives with Mrs. Rebecca Joy (Dexter mansion, State Street, Littleport).
- Nat Jardin ("Uncle Nat"): old lightkeeper, Harbor Light Island; rheumatism; "cal'late."
- Ma Stafford: housekeeper, Nat's partner.
- Lyddy Ann: maid-of-all-work at Mrs. Joy's; scared of ghosts.
- Mrs. Rebecca Joy: sea-captain's widow.
- Myron and Marian Langdon: 4-year-old twins; "Mawyann"; Marian lisps.
- Harvey Langdon: Montana rancher (Three-bar Ranch), father of twins.
- Sadie Brown ("Brownie"): twins' nurse, Western, brusque; later marries George Belden.
- Teddy Ford: curly-haired, brown-hair boy; cattle-boat worker; from Montana (father a pocket hunter/prospector, died); accused by Langdon of stealing silver chest; says "Gee."
- Payton Orr: substitute lightkeeper, gossip.
- Anson Cope: iceboat owner (*Bluebird*) who nearly ran them down.
- Shedder Crabbe; Enos Crabbe (storekeeper, town council); Jingo (ram); May Rabey; Minnie and Flossy Payne; Busy Bees society.
- Billy Bragg: cabin boy of *Adrian Marple*; saved (per sailor).
- Ching Foo: Three-bar cook, pidgin English, queue, coffin.
- George Belden: trail foreman, blue eyes, humorous mouth; loves Sadie.
- Sol Perkins: ranch manager (Louisiana drawl).
- Lenny, Long Jim, Charley, Big Ike: cowpunchers.
- Hank Ridley (Tony Ridley), Shaffer, Tom Mudd: suspected thieves, "three bad men."
- Molly: Oriole's blue pony. Blooey: old pony.

**Events in order**
1. Frost; Oriole takes twins on sled to Harbor Light Island. Iceboat *Bluebird* breaks ice; Oriole, twins into water. Teddy Ford rescues Marian, Myron, Oriole. Taken to Nat's cottage. Teddy flees after learning twins are Langdon's.
2. Teddy's story: worked on Langdon ranch 3 months; accused of stealing silver chest; ran away; plans to return to Montana. Ching Foo's "pidgin" remark: "Three topside bad men—allee same talkee-talkee. Melican boy look out!" Teddy leaves by boat.
3. Langdon thanks Oriole, but still suspects Teddy. Langdon invites Oriole West.
4. Learns from Boston seaman that Oriole's father Mr. Putnam drowned; mother possibly taken aboard the *Ellerton* (three-masted; Capt. Nathan Grimsby).
5. Shedder's ram Jingo wrecks Busy Bees sun parlor; Enos Crabbe accuses Oriole of stealing sheep; Jingo chases Crabbe. Surprise party. Departure Monday for West.
6. Train: Oriole sees Teddy in stock car with race horses; he promises "by the spring round-up."
7. Ranch: mad cow; Oriole leaps from buckboard with twins. Branding calf. Range camp; "Beds!" Molly the pony.
8. Oriole overhears Ridley, Shaffer, Mudd about "prospect hole" and "Three Sisters." Lariat catches Teddy behind stump.
9. Eagle attacks Myron; Teddy lassos eagle; Langdon forgives Teddy ("a new deal"), offers job.
10. Fishing trip Squaw Canyon; Oriole catches bear's trout; bear shot by Belden. Horses stolen; Oriole follows Ridley/Mudd; they kidnap twins with Sadie's pistol taken; Sadie thrown from horse.
11. Teddy and Oriole follow to waterfall; find hidden path behind falls (secret). Shaffer caught by posse. Teddy found silver chest in prospect hole; Hank Ridley rescued.
12. Oriole's wrist watch (New Year's gift from Myron) lost near bowlder. Telegram: Mother alive, picked up by *Ellerton*; Mrs. Putnam reunion at Timmins Station. Oriole stays with Langdon ("another one just like it").
